description: Resolve and inspect one brand profile without rendering an artifact. Use references such as brand://acme/primary.

surface.description: Optional output surface used to select light/dark values

name: inspect_brand

description: Inspect and validate one brand-owned template without changing the brandbook.
name: inspect_brand_template

description: List read-only brand-owned page and slide templates available in a brandbook.
name: list_brand_templates

description: List locally configured brandbooks and their named profiles. Brandbooks are discovered below the configured report-baby brand directory.
name: list_brandbooks

description: List every template a render call can reference: built-in A4 report templates for render_report, built-in slide templates for the render_slides_* tools, and — when brand_ref is given — the brand-owned templates of that brandbook. Each entry says which tools accept it and whether it is builtin or brand-owned.

brand_ref.description: Optional brand reference, e.g. brand://acme/primary, to also list that brandbook's templates

name: list_templates

description: Render a bar, line, or pie chart to a standalone PNG from data values. Returns the path to the written PNG. This is the primary tool for charts to paste into a report or document.

surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

name: render_chart

description: Render a grid of KPI / metric cards (label, big value, optional delta with up/down trend color) to a standalone PNG. Returns the path to the written PNG.

surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

name: render_metric_cards

description: Opinionated end-of-task deliverable: a built-in styled template plus structured data → polished A4 PDF (default-report/campaign-summary or a configurable page template such as pages/editorial-two-column). All data fields are optional — only present blocks render, in the order: header, intro, kpis, charts, sections, table, highlights. Returns the path to the written PDF. Use this for the final client-facing report.

brand.description: Client/company name shown in the top-left corner

footer.description: Shown on every page; keep under ~120 chars

highlights.description: Bullet list rendered under a "Highlights" heading

highlights_title.description: Heading above the bullet list; defaults to "Highlights"

kpis.description: KPI cards; keep labels under ~28 chars to avoid clipping

period.description: Reporting period shown in the top-right corner; keep short

sections.description: Narrative sections; heading stays on the same page as the body. level 2 renders a subheading under the preceding level 1 chapter. Body text accepts **bold** inline markup

title_page.description: Full-bleed cover page rendered as page 1 instead of the compact header; the body starts on page 2

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase kicker above the cover title

period.description: Reporting period shown in the cover top-right corner

diagnostics.description: Response detail. "summary" (default) returns the written path, resolved brand profile, page count and warnings. "full" adds the resolved report layout plan for every page.

surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

template.description: Built-in A4 report template name, from list_templates: default-report, campaign-summary or a pages/* template

template_ref.description: Alternative way to name the built-in A4 report template; must be one of the list_templates report names. Slide composition references such as slides/two-column are rejected here — they belong to the render_slides_* tools

name: render_report

description: Render a complete presentation as a local 16:9 PDF from a bounded shared slide model. Existing render_report A4 behavior is unchanged. Returns the PDF path plus a compact render summary; pass diagnostics: "full" only to debug slide layout.

notes.description: Speaker notes / narration for this slide: never drawn on the slide. render_slides_pptx writes them to the PowerPoint notes slide shown in presenter view; render_slides_pdf and render_slides_png drop them and report it as a warning.

columns.description: Exactly two side-by-side columns; pair it with template_ref "slides/two-column" for the matching layout

diagnostics.description: Response detail. "summary" (default) returns the written path plus the resolved brand profile, template_ref, slide count and deduplicated warnings. "full" adds the per-slide pixel layout plans (slidePlans, slotRules, slot boxes) — thousands of tokens per deck, so ask for it only when debugging a layout.

surface.description: Output surface, e.g. pdf-a4 or pptx-16x9

name: render_slides_pdf

description: Check for plugin updates and download them. Reports the version installed on disk separately from the version this process is actually running, because a running MCP server cannot swap its own bundle — the download only takes effect after a session restart.
name: update_plugin
